sumakhos.name: Sumakhos
sumakhos.bio: Tanna, a student of Rabbi Meir, who often transmits rulings in his name.
sumakhos.prompt: A sharp-witted sage of the Land of Israel in his 40s with a trimmed dark beard and an ochre wool mantle, counting off reasons on his fingers; background of a stone study house with an oil lamp and a scroll shelf.

mar-brei-derabbanan.name: Mar, son of the Sages
mar-brei-derabbanan.bio: Amora who, with Rav Naḥumi bar Zekharya, interprets a baraita on Rabbi Eliezer’s view in Keritot 15a.
mar-brei-derabbanan.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a short brown beard and a grey-blue wool mantle, explaining a baraita with an open hand to a companion beside him; background of a study hall with a scroll shelf, lit by an oil lamp.
